description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ArgumentPluginBase' for view argument (contextual filter) handler plugins in Drupal. It includes methods for configuration, validation, cache dependencies, and plugin management related to view arguments.

classes.name: ArgumentPluginBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for argument (contextual filter) handler plugins in Drupal views, providing configuration, validation, cache, and plugin management functionalities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with view, display, and options, setting name field and table if defined.

methods.name: isException
methods.description: Checks if the current argument matches an exception value.

methods.name: exceptionTitle
methods.description: Returns the override title for an exception argument if enabled.

methods.name: needsStylePlugin
methods.description: Determines if the argument requires a style plugin based on default actions.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines configurable options for the argument plugin.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of trusted callback methods, including 'preRenderMoveArgumentOptions'.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the argument plugin, including validation, token help, and default actions.

methods.name: getTokenHelp
methods.description: Provides token replacement pattern help for the argument.

methods.name: validateOptionsForm
methods.description: Validates the options form, delegating to sub-plugins.

methods.name: submitOptionsForm
methods.description: Processes and saves submitted options, delegating to sub-plugins.

methods.name: defaultActions
methods.description: Returns default behaviors for the argument, such as ignore, default, not found, etc.

methods.name: defaultArgumentForm
methods.description: Builds form for selecting default argument type.

methods.name: defaultSummaryForm
methods.description: Builds form for selecting summary display options.

methods.name: defaultAction
methods.description: Executes the default action based on configuration.

methods.name: validateFail
methods.description: Performs validation failure action.

methods.name: defaultIgnore
methods.description: Default behavior: ignore the argument.

methods.name: defaultNotFound
methods.description: Default behavior: mark view as 'not found'.

methods.name: defaultAccessDenied
methods.description: Default behavior: mark view as 'access denied'.

methods.name: defaultEmpty
methods.description: Default behavior: show empty result.

methods.name: defaultDefault
methods.description: Returns true, indicating argument location is known.

methods.name: hasDefaultArgument
methods.description: Checks if a default argument is configured.

methods.name: getDefaultArgument
methods.description: Retrieves the default argument plugin if available.

methods.name: processSummaryArguments
methods.description: Allows validation plugin to modify arguments for URL.

methods.name: defaultSummary
methods.description: Builds a summary query for the argument.

methods.name: summaryQuery
methods.description: Sets up the query for summary, including group by and count.

methods.name: summaryNameField
methods.description: Adds the name field for summaries.

methods.name: summaryBasics
methods.description: Adds basic info like count to summary query.

methods.name: summarySort
methods.description: Sorts the summary results.

methods.name: summaryArgument
methods.description: Returns the argument value for a summary row.

methods.name: summaryName
methods.description: Returns the display name for a summary row.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Prepares the query with where condition based on argument.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the title for the argument.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns validated or default title.

methods.name: validateArgument
methods.description: Validates the argument value using plugin.

methods.name: validateMenuArgument
methods.description: Validates argument with soft fail consideration.

methods.name: setArgument
methods.description: Sets and validates the argument.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the argument value, computing if necessary.

methods.name: getPlugin
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin instance for argument default, validator, or style.

methods.name: getSortName
methods.description: Returns default sort name.

methods.name: processContainerRadios
methods.description: Processes radio button options in form.

methods.name: preRenderMoveArgumentOptions
methods.description: Rearranges form elements based on argument options.

methods.name: encodeValidatorId
methods.description: Sanitizes validator ID for JavaScript.

methods.name: decodeValidatorId
methods.description: Reverts sanitized validator ID.

methods.name: unpackArgumentValue
methods.description: Splits argument string into value and operator.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Calculates cache max age considering sub-plugins.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Gathers cache contexts from sub-plugins.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Gathers cache tags from sub-plugins.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates plugin dependencies.

methods.name: getContextDefinition
methods.description: Returns context definition for the argument.

methods.name: adminSummary
methods.description: Provides admin summary of the plugin configuration.
